verdicts.decision_note: The client specifies automatic background creation of a non-custodial wallet for new fiat buyers without initial seed-phrase or manual wallet setup.
The client defers the Transak-dependent fiat wallet-provisioning flow until after the crypto-only launch while retaining it for later implementation.
The client changes product rollout behavior so the Transak-dependent wallet-provisioning path applies after the initial crypto-only launch.
